steps.title: What an encoder says
steps.say: Each drive motor has an **encoder** that counts how far the wheel has turned, in rotations.

board.code:
drive.getLeftPositionRotations()  // how far, in rotations
drive.getLeftVelocityRps()        // how fast, in rotations per second

steps.title: Rotations to meters
steps.say: One rotation moves the robot one wheel **circumference**: 2 x pi x radius.

board.code:
double metersPerRotation = 2.0 * Math.PI * Constants.WHEEL_RADIUS_METERS;
double leftMeters = drive.getLeftPositionRotations() * metersPerRotation;

steps.title: Open Robot.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Robot` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find STEP 1
steps.say: It's in robotPeriodic(). Press **Ctrl+F**, type `STEP 1` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: STEP 1
steps.say: Fill in the right side the same way the left is done.

steps.title: Start the robot
steps.say: Your code only runs once it's built and started.

waitFor.hint: press Start and wait for Running.

steps.title: Enable in Teleop
steps.say: Pick **Teleop** and press **Enable**. Robot code runs only while it's enabled.

steps.title: Watch it count
steps.say: Drive forward and watch the distance grow. In AdvantageScope, search for `Distance`, then drag **Robot/Distance** onto the **Left Axis**.
